contract: A credit-limited partial packet follows the previous interval contiguously and retains its recorded input. Local-only prediction still batches six steps. Headless producers account for actual packet steps within the existing 12-step work budget. Admission, expiry, lookahead, and queue bounds are unchanged.
regressions: A four-step credit remainder is transmitted without waiting for another acknowledgment.
The remainder preserves recorded direction and ends at the verified credit ceiling.
Another producer wake sends nothing when credit is exhausted and does not advance prediction.
limitations: An initial regression fixture used an invalid prediction time delta and failed; the corrected fixture uses two valid advances and all focused tests pass.
Updated client builds and crowded performance acceptance remain pending.
